fusions.name: Hurled Maul
fusions.desc: Hurls the head at a target up to 8 tiles away for 30 damage, rising to twice that at full reach. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Haft Jab
fusions.desc: A jab with the haft that deals 11 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Point Forward
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Dry Spell Spike
fusions.desc: When you go a while without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
